defects.detail: source is a Joseon text on the 金縢 affair, 先大王, 儲宮, 思悼 (Sado), 孝章; translation narrates the Tang coup of Li Chongjun/Li Duozuo, Shangguan Wan'er, Wei Yuanzhong
none of the source's content (金縢之事, 世孫移宗於孝章, 思悼之冤) appears in the translation

reason: Translation is of a different text entirely (Tang court history) with no counterpart to the source's Joseon Geumdeung/Sado discussion.
Close, complete rendering of the French throughout; nothing found wrong.

defects.detail: 'ונזכרו שמות חז'' (names of the sages/Chazal) rendered 'the names of the seven who are liable'
'כבוד ה' המלך' rendered 'the honor of the King of the King'
margin 'כבוד מלכנו שקיוס מעלינו' rendered 'the honor of our King, [His] mercy upon us'

reason: Heavily garbled OCR rendered word-for-word, keeping its incoherence rather than smoothing it; a few slips (חז' as 'seven'); I read this garbled Hebrew with only moderate confidence.

defects.detail: English source reworded: 'at the bottom of most of the mischief' -> 'at the root of most of the trouble'; 'a cheat' -> 'a trick'; 'The supposition' -> 'The suggestion'

reason: English-to-English copy with a few needless paraphrases ('supposition'->'suggestion', 'cheat'->'trick'); meaning otherwise identical.

defects.detail: 'von Lucien 95. biß zu Gregori 96' / 'civilischen 95. Jahr' expanded to 1595/1596 without the century in the source

reason: Faithful to the five-season division and the planetary positions (10° Cancer, 7° Pisces, Jupiter at 25°); the years 95/96 are expanded to 1595/1596 by assumption.

defects.detail: 'τὸ γὰρ ἀναγκαῖον μὴ εἶναι, οὐκ ἀναγκαῖον εἶναι' (what is necessary not to be is not necessary to be) rendered 'the necessary not to be <note>and</note> the not necessary to be', losing the predication
'ταῖς μὲν ἐκείνων καταφάσεσιν' (the affirmations of those [possible/contingent]) rendered 'their affirmations', which is ambiguous

reason: Accurate for the Aristotle lemma and Ammonius's diagram discussion; the lemma's final clause is garbled with an inserted 'and', and 'ἐκείνων' becomes an ambiguous 'their'.
Both asteroid tables reproduced with every value intact; labels translated (T->D for days, Neapel->Naples). Nothing found wrong.

defects.detail: <meta> asserts 'The previous page's translation described a Neoplatonic or Christian ethical text regarding the soul and virtue', which the source does not carry
'τὸ ἐνεργεῖν τοῦτο ἐπὶ τῷ κινητικῷ' (this acting upon/belonging to the mover) rendered 'to exercise this activity upon the movable'

reason: Faithful rendering of Physics III.3 (agent/patient, teaching/learning, Thebes-Athens road); an added meta note invents the previous page's content; one κινητικῷ is misread as 'movable'.
All three optativa and their proxima (sails, windmills, forecasting winds; Arts. 26, 27, 32) rendered faithfully; nothing found wrong.

defects.detail: opening <meta> asserts previous-page content ('Most Fanatics derive the Spirit from the very essence of God ... Deification') not on this page
'hypothesi suæ de tertia hominis parte' (the third part of man) rendered 'the three parts of man'
garbled 'fione act. V.' (likely [confes]sione art. V) rendered 'in the fifth act'

reason: Barclay/Schwenckfeld/Halberstadt argument rendered faithfully; slips on 'tertia hominis parte' and 'act. V.', plus an invented meta summary of the previous page.

defects.detail: adds 'The definition of a substance is that which possesses action and qualities and is the inherent cause. 10.', which has no counterpart in the source (ends at the Hindi gloss on reason 8 'जैसे तरुण पदार्थमें')
Hindi glosses dropped: '(केवल एक रसना इंद्रियसे रसका ग्रहण होता है)', '(शालपर्णी)', '(नींबू)', '(अरनी)'; the separate Hindi commentary for 6-7 is merged into the sutra renderings
'न रसाद्य उपदिश्यंते' (tastes etc. are not prescribed) rendered 'not just the tastes'

reason: Reasons 3-9 are rendered correctly, but it adds a sutra 10 defining substance that is not on the page and drops several Hindi glosses.

defects.detail: opening <meta> asserts 'the previous discussion on the effects of mineral waters on external objects', which the source does not carry

reason: Chapters I-III (sampling, separating spirits in the cucurbit, evaporation and coagulation, alum from attramentum, salt from halinitrum) rendered accurately; the only defect is an invented meta line about the previous page.
Latin-German macaronic text (flies from air, lizards from earth, spiders from fire, snakes from water; cure of worms from poison) rendered faithfully; nothing found wrong.
